## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed. Link relevant **public** issues if available.

## Validation

- [ ] `ruff check src tests`
- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] Applicable GUI, Windows, macOS, packaging or integration checks
- [ ] CI is passing on the latest PR head before merge

Note checks not run or blocked, and explain why.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] No research data, credentials, local caches or signing material included
- [ ] Public PR description is self-contained and contains no confidential documents or links
- [ ] TeAL/GeCo scientific and coding ownership boundaries remain respected
- [ ] Frozen research environments and existing project state are not silently modified

## Limitations / follow-up

List any outstanding work or known risks; use "None" if not applicable.
